result.title: Query-Aware vs. Query-Agnostic Training-Free Video Token Pruning in Multimodal LLMs
result.summary: Video Large Language Models process large numbers of visual tokens, making token pruning important for efficient inference. Training-free pruning methods differ in whether and how they use the user query, and the value of query conditioning remains unclear. We present a controlled study of training-free, pre-LLM video token selection. Using a shared Qwen-3-VL backbone, token budgets, and decoding settings, we compare 21 pruning principles spanning query-agnostic, shallow query-conditioned, structured query-conditioned, and holistic strategies. To instantiate the last two categories, we introduce Structured Query Pruning, which decomposes the question into semantic anchors, and a Pareto variant, which combines anchor relevance with query-agnostic visual diversity. Across Video-MME, MVBench, and LongVideoBench, relevance computed from the raw question embedding is unreliable (8--16 points below the best methods), whereas anchors derived from query decomposition avoid this failure. However, query access is not inherently advantageous: strong query-agnostic coverage methods remain competitive or superior in the full-field comparison. Relative to a redundancy-only baseline, structured selection helps most on evidence-specific and long-context tasks at tight budgets; on broad tasks, the holistic selector improves over either relevance or redundancy alone. Further, pruning reduces cost and memory. These results support a practical design rule: preserve visual coverage by default, and add structured relevance when the task and token budget demand selective evidence retrieval.

AI.brief_summary: 论文在统一的 Qwen-3-VL 骨干、token 预算与解码设置下，系统比较 21 种免训练的视频视觉 token 选择策略（查询无关、浅层查询条件、结构化查询条件与整体式），并提出把问题分解为语义锚点的 Structured Query Pruning 及其结合视觉多样性的 Pareto 变体，在 Video-MME、MVBench、LongVideoBench 上评估。
AI.relevance_reason: 该研究直接检验「哪些视觉证据被保留/丢弃」这一视觉旁路与信息保留问题，其结论——原始问题嵌入的相关性不可靠、结构化锚点更稳、强查询无关覆盖法仍有竞争力——可供核查 LVR 中证据筛选与压缩预算下的细节保真问题。
